sections.text: Introduction
This document outlines equipment inspection I1, to be preformed every 2000WH as indicated by H2000 in the title block.

The 
motor of the pump: type ANVE - WT 001, Teco Electric & Machinery Co. LTD Taiwan

The first draft initiated by eng. Hany Samoiel Ibrahem, reviewed by eng. Hamza 
 Helmy El-Sayed Alshafie, tested by eng. Mohamed Alkhateb Mohamed Salem, accepted by eng. Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Hassan Zayed, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of 
 Sidi Kirir Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 Engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category
Wearing safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

The motor have to be stopped and its breaker isolated before starting any 
 maintenance procedure

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the (teeth, 
grease, gear seals, sealing faces) coupling and alignment coupling (air gap:56 
(tolerance +2,-5)mm, radial:0.127, axial 0.33)

Verify and check the 
oil (viscosity, acid No. & contamination) for thrust bearing (pump and motor) 
and change if required

Verify the grease 
mobil plex 47 for lower bearing of motor and change if required

Check the tighten of all 
bolts for the pump and motor

Clean the cooling water 
pipes of thrust bearings (pump and motor)

Check all valves (drains, 
vents, ... etc)

General cleaning for the 
external pump body

Check the packing (4 pieces 
- 20mm - CF - P), lantern ring shaft protecting sleeve and change if 
required

Check the cooling for the 
packing

Introduction
This document outlines equipment inspection I1, to be preformed every 2000WH as indicated by H2000 in the title block.
The 
motor of the pump: type ANVE - WT 001, Teco Electric & Machinery Co. LTD Taiwan
The first draft initiated by eng. Hany Samoiel Ibrahem, reviewed by eng. Hamza 
 Helmy El-Sayed Alshafie, tested by eng. Mohamed Alkhateb Mohamed Salem, accepted by eng. Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Hassan Zayed, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of 
 Sidi Kirir Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 Engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category
Wearing safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes

Electrical isolation
 | 6.3kv breaker 1NB0113 | Open
 | DC supply | Off
 | Vibration monitor 9NHA31A-IBG-15 | Open
 | Space heater 9NHA-31A-ICH-25 | Open
 | Discharge valve 9NHA-31A-IFJ | Open
 | Cathodic protection of suction pit | Off
Mechanical isolation
 | Chlorination injection manual valve | Closed
 | Discharge valve IDA-HV001 A | Closed
